# AI Briefing for Obsidian

> Obsidian plugin that collects AI news daily from 14+ curated sources and generates a weekly LLM-curated briefing note, with multi-provider support (Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, Google Gemini, Ollama).

The plugin runs inside Obsidian (desktop). Daily background collection fetches articles from RSS feeds and APIs (HuggingFace, Hacker News, ArXiv, Reddit, GitHub) into a cache; once a week the configured LLM curates them into a structured Markdown note with YAML frontmatter, categorized sections, relevance scores, and an "Article of the Week" highlight. A preview modal lets the user edit before saving.

Tech stack: TypeScript, esbuild, Obsidian Plugin API. All source code lives in a single file, `main.ts`, following Obsidian's single-file convention. HTTP goes through Obsidian's `requestUrl` wrapper only. Settings and article cache persist via `loadData`/`saveData` in `data.json`, which also stores API keys. Free-tier providers (Groq, Mistral, Gemini, Ollama) are supported out of the box.

## Source

- [main.ts](https://github.com/fredrsat/obsidian-ai-briefing/blob/main/main.ts): entire plugin — sources, collection, LLM providers, digest generation, settings UI, preview modal
- [manifest.json](https://github.com/fredrsat/obsidian-ai-briefing/blob/main/manifest.json): Obsidian plugin manifest
- [styles.css](https://github.com/fredrsat/obsidian-ai-briefing/blob/main/styles.css): plugin styling
